design_brief: A smaller shared-break alternative to coffee, not another large counter. V2 changes only the native reservoir silhouette rejected in v1. Base elevation, top-plane geometry, floor contact, canvas, pivot, masks and layers remain fixed.
gameplay_scope: Art and future layout proposal only; no new hiring, role behavior, tool authority, transaction or interaction is implemented.

current_availability.direction_art_review: N/E/S/W water-station-v2 passive art passes the 2026-09-06 agent-native review. The rejected narrow-reservoir v1 remains preserved. V2 uses a supported broad stepped jug, exact footprint-derived top planes, separate contact geometry, fixed light, clean layers/anchors and actual GameMain wall/route/depth evidence. Approval is passive-library only; no water service, animation, production/runtime binding, default placement, interaction, hire, role pose or backend is claimed.

previous_catalogue_availability.direction_art_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged canvas coordinate represents local floor pivot [0,0] in every direction and every layer. Transparent padding is not sprite scaling.

dimension_review.revision: Water v2 replaces only the rejected narrow reservoir with a supported broad stepped jug; base elevation, footprint top plane, contact geometry, canvas, pivot, scale and masks stay unchanged.

native_geometry.top_plane_contract: For each facing, top_plane_px is exactly floor_plane_px translated upward by one family-wide base elevation, with identical footprint width/depth; solid fronts reach floor contact and the open cart retains a measured transparent tray interval.

variants.redraw_requirement: Draw the actual north service front; operator approaches that side looking south. Fixed screen floor axes and upper-left light; do not rotate or mirror finished raster art. No implemented interaction is implied.
